snippet.title: Total Chaos - Official Demo Trailer | Indie Horror Showcase 2025
snippet.description:
Scavenge parts to make weapons in the ruins of Fort Oasis as you try to stay one step ahead of shadowy figures from another place. Can the voice on the walkie be trusted? Survive, if you can, when Total Chaos comes to Steam and Steam VR soon, and jump into the Steam demo now.

#ign #gaming
